tldr: 台股週二重挫 2,030.83 點、跌幅 4.65%，終場收 41,603.36 點，寫下史上第三大收盤跌點，全球晶片股崩跌、中國 DUV 曝光機自製傳聞與韓股熔斷式暴跌重擊市場信心。
台積電跌 70 元至 2,280 元（跌 2.98%），失守約 2,347 元的季線，半導體 AI 族群評價全面下修，市場情緒由貪婪轉為恐懼。
政策面，金管會最快 7 月底公布 7 家銀行內部評等法（IRB）准駁、有助釋放資本，並同步推動跨業聯防機制以抑制散戶槓桿風險。
海外方面，南韓 KOSPI 暴跌逾 10% 觸發熔斷，三星與 SK 海力士崩跌；美股分歧，道瓊靠強勁財報漲約 520 點，那斯達克則因 AI 支出疑慮逼近修正區。
台灣內部，智庫維持 2026 高成長預測、景氣續亮紅燈，稅制面則調升遺產稅級距並放寬繼承房地持有期間認定。

items.title_zh: 台股崩跌 2,030 點，寫史上第三大跌點
items.title_en: TAIEX plunges 2,030 points in third-worst point drop ever
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週二終場收 41,603.36 點，重挫 2,030.83 點、跌幅 4.65%，為史上最大單日跌點之一，成交量爆增至約 1.23 兆元。電子權值股遭全面調節，反映美股與亞股晶片股隔夜崩跌。專家點出 40,000～42,000 點為短線支撐，並示警 AI 評價疑慮與槓桿去化恐使盤面續呈高波動，投資人宜控管風險、留意季線與外資動向。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index collapsed 2,030.83 points, or 4.65%, on Tuesday to finish at 41,603.36, one of the steepest single-day point losses in its history. Turnover swelled to about NT$1.23tn as electronic heavyweights were dumped en masse, tracking an overnight rout in US and Asian chip stocks. Analysts flagged 40,000–42,000 as near-term support, warning that AI-valuation jitters and forced deleveraging could keep the tape volatile in coming sessions.

items.title_zh: 台積電摜破季線，台達電盤中一度跌停
items.title_en: TSMC breaks below quarterly line as Delta hits limit-down intraday
items.summary_zh: 權值王台積電收 2,280 元、下跌 70 元、跌幅 2.98%，跌破約 2,347 元的季線，為入春以來首見。賣壓擴散至全盤，台達電盤中一度摜至跌停 10% 後收斂，記憶體股華邦電、南亞科同步重挫。指標性技術支撐失守，凸顯 AI 樂觀情緒迅速轉為法人防禦性操作，短線多空易位、盤面結構轉弱，宜審慎因應。
items.summary_en: Market leader TSMC dropped NT$70 to close at NT$2,280, down 2.98%, slipping under its quarterly moving average around 2,347 for the first time since the spring. Losses spread across the index: Delta Electronics briefly tumbled to its 10% limit-down before paring, and memory names Winbond and Nanya fell sharply. The break of key technical support underscored how quickly AI-driven optimism has flipped to defensive positioning among institutions.

items.title_zh: 中國 DUV 曝光機自製傳聞，撼動全球晶片供應鏈
items.title_en: China DUV-tool self-sufficiency rumors rattle global chip supply chain
items.summary_zh: 市場傳出中國已具備深紫外光（DUV）曝光機國產自製能力，衝擊半導體類股，市場憂心成熟製程恐面臨供給過剩與價格壓力。美股晶片股走跌，費城半導體指數下跌逾 4%、美光挫約 9%，台積電 ADR 亦跌約 2%。對以晶圓代工為核心的台灣供應鏈而言，此傳聞在 AI 評價已高之際，再添地緣政治與競爭面的不確定變數，後續量產進度與良率仍待觀察。
items.summary_en: Reports that China has achieved domestic production capability for deep-ultraviolet (DUV) lithography equipment sent shockwaves through the semiconductor sector, stoking fears of an eventual supply glut and pricing pressure in mature nodes. US chip stocks slid, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down more than 4% and Micron off around 9%, while TSMC's ADR fell about 2%. For Taiwan's foundry-centric supply chain, the news adds a fresh geopolitical and competitive overhang atop already-stretched AI valuations.

items.title_zh: AI 資本支出疑慮升溫，市場情緒由貪婪轉恐懼
items.title_en: AI-capex doubts flip market mood from greed to fear
items.summary_zh: 分析師指出，本波半導體賣壓反映市場對 AI 資本支出可持續性的疑慮加深，並非單一利空，投資人如今傾向將所有消息負面解讀。電子權值股首當其衝評價下修，台積電季線攻防被視為大盤關鍵技術戰場。此番情緒轉折出現在 AI 領漲數月之後，後市恐由指數方向轉為個股輪動與精選操作，波動加大之際更須留意資金流向與基本面分歧。
items.summary_en: Strategists said the semiconductor sell-off reflects deepening scepticism over the sustainability of AI capital spending rather than a single catalyst, with investors now reading every headline negatively. Electronic heavyweights bore the brunt of the de-rating, and the defense of TSMC's quarterly line was cited as the key technical battleground for the broader market. The shift marks a sentiment inflection after months of AI-led gains, raising the odds of continued rotation and stock-picking over index-level direction.

items.title_zh: 金管會最快 7 月底核定 7 家銀行採內部評等法
items.title_en: FSC to clear seven banks for internal-ratings-based approach by end-July
items.summary_zh: 金管會對 7 家銀行申請採用信用風險內部評等法（IRB）的審查已進入尾聲，最快 7 月底公布結果，過關銀行 8 月起即可採用。申請者包含 6 家系統性重要銀行（中信、國泰世華、台北富邦、合庫、兆豐、第一銀）加上玉山銀。獲准後可降低風險性資產、減輕資本計提壓力，並釋放放款與配息空間，對相關金控資本效率與股東回報具正面挹注，為近期金融股少數利多。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission's review of seven banks' applications to adopt the credit-risk internal-ratings-based (IRB) approach is in its final stage, with results due as early as end-July and approved banks able to use the method from August. Applicants include six domestic systemically important banks — CTBC, Cathay United, Taipei Fubon, TCB, Mega and First — plus E.Sun. Approval would lower risk-weighted assets, easing capital requirements and creating room for expanded lending and dividends.

items.title_zh: 金管會推跨業聯防機制，抑制散戶槓桿風險
items.title_en: FSC pushes cross-industry joint-defense to curb retail leverage
items.summary_zh: 面對散戶以信貸買股增加，金管會銀行局表示多重貸款戶比例僅個位數、銀行逾放比維持 0.14%～0.16%，整體風險可控。為防範過度槓桿，主管機關加速推動銀行與券商間的「跨業聯防機制」，未來將雙向交換信用資訊。截至 6 月底，小額信貸餘額 8,096 億元、年增 12.12%，增幅居各類個人貸款之冠，顯示消費信用擴張須審慎控管，聯防機制上路後有助強化風險監理與資訊透明。
items.summary_en: With retail investors increasingly using personal loans to buy stocks, the FSC's banking bureau said multiple-loan borrowers remain in the single-digit percentages and banks' non-performing-loan ratio is steady at 0.14%–0.16%, keeping overall risk contained. To pre-empt excessive leverage, regulators are accelerating a cross-industry "joint-defense mechanism" enabling two-way credit-information exchange between banks and brokerages. Small-ticket personal loans grew 12.12% year-on-year to NT$809.6bn, the fastest among consumer-loan categories.

items.title_zh: 富豪財管規模逼近 2.7 兆元，高階客戶年增逾 7 成
items.title_en: High-net-worth wealth pool nears NT$2.7tn as elite clients jump over 70%
items.summary_zh: 台灣高資產「財管 2.0」架構下的管理資產規模已攀升至近 2.7 兆元，頂級客戶數年增逾 7 成，國銀競逐快速擴張的高資產客群。該制度放寬合格銀行對資產達 1 億元以上客戶提供更多元商品與諮詢服務，吸引愈來愈多銀行與保險業者投入，在股市波動加劇之際，財富管理business已成金融機構的策略性獲利引擎，惟高資產客戶風險屬性與商品適配仍為經營重點。
items.summary_en: Assets under Taiwan's high-asset "Wealth Management 2.0" framework have climbed toward NT$2.7tn, with the number of top-tier clients growing more than 70% year-on-year, as banks race to capture a fast-expanding affluent market. The regime, which lets qualified banks offer a wider menu of products and advisory to clients with at least NT$100mn in assets, has drawn a growing roster of institutions and insurers, reinforcing wealth management as a strategic profit engine amid volatile equity markets.

items.title_zh: 半導體收益 ETF 00927 殖利率 18.01% 登頂
items.title_en: Semiconductor-income ETF 00927 tops yield rankings at 18.01%
items.summary_zh: 群益半導體收益 ETF（00927）以 18.01% 的年化殖利率登上 7 月配息排行榜首位，單季配息 1.88 元、創歷史新高，收益型商品持續吸引追求現金流的散戶資金。此現象凸顯主題式高配息 ETF 即便在股市重挫之際仍吸金，惟分析師提醒，帳面高殖利率可能受資本利得墊高、未必可持續，投資人應綜合評估總報酬與成分股體質，避免僅以殖利率為單一選擇依據，方能兼顧收益與風險。
items.summary_en: Capital Semiconductor Income ETF (00927) led July's high-yield rankings with an annualized yield of 18.01%, distributing NT$1.88 per unit for the quarter — a record high — as income-focused products draw yield-hungry retail demand. The surge underscores how thematic, high-distribution ETFs continue to gather assets even amid a sharp equity sell-off, though analysts caution that headline yields can be flattered by capital gains and may not be sustainable, urging investors to weigh total return and underlying holdings.

items.title_zh: 2026 遺產稅級距因通膨調整調升
items.title_en: Estate-tax brackets lifted for 2026 as inflation adjustment kicks in
items.summary_zh: 台灣 2026 年遺產稅課稅級距因累計 CPI 漲幅達 12.42% 的調整門檻而上修，使高資產家庭的實質稅負相對減輕；贈與稅免稅額則維持 244 萬元不變。級距門檻上調意味更多遺產適用較低邊際稅率課稅，雖屬溫和調整仍具實質減稅效果，也再度凸顯及早進行結構化傳承與贈與規劃的重要性，高資產族群宜把握級距與免稅額的節稅空間。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's estate-tax brackets have been raised for 2026 after cumulative CPI gains reached the 12.42% adjustment threshold, easing the effective tax burden on high-net-worth families, while the annual gift-tax exemption stays unchanged at NT$2.44mn. The upward reset of bracket thresholds means a larger slice of estates is taxed at lower marginal rates, a modest but meaningful relief that reinforces the case for early, structured succession and gifting planning.

items.title_zh: 財政部放寬繼承房地持有期間計算規定
items.title_en: MOF relaxes holding-period rule for inherited property under house-and-land tax
items.summary_zh: 財政部放寬個人交易因連續繼承或受遺贈取得房地時，計算房地合一所得稅持有期間的規定，讓納稅人在更多情形下得併計被繼承人持有時間，協助繼承人出售繼承不動產時避免適用最高 45% 的短期重稅稅率。此釋令降低徵納爭議，對家族跨世代不動產移轉提供更明確、合理的課稅認定，也讓繼承人處分祖產時的稅務成本更具可預期性。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance has eased how the holding period is calculated for property acquired through successive inheritance or bequest when computing house-and-land unified income tax. The change lets taxpayers count the decedent's holding time in more cases, helping heirs avoid punitive short-term rates of up to 45% when they sell inherited real estate. The clarification reduces disputes and provides clearer, fairer treatment for families managing intergenerational property transfers.

items.title_zh: 智庫上修 2026 經濟成長預測，AI 出口熱潮領軍
items.title_en: Think tank lifts 2026 growth forecast on AI-driven export boom
items.summary_zh: 中華經濟研究院最新預測指出，2026 全年經濟成長動能強勁，AI、高效能運算與先進製程半導體需求持續拉抬出口與企業資本支出。廠商擴大產能，加上股市走揚帶動財富效果支撐消費，使台灣成為全球少數維持穩健成長的經濟體。惟全年 CPI 年增率預估約 2.02%、略高於央行 2% 的舒適區，物價黏性與外部景氣波動仍為後續政策關注焦點。
items.summary_en: CIER's latest forecast points to robust full-year economic growth for 2026, powered by strong demand for AI, high-performance computing and advanced-node semiconductors that continues to lift exports and corporate capital expenditure. Firms are expanding capacity while a rising stock market feeds a wealth effect that supports consumption, keeping Taiwan among the few major economies sustaining solid momentum. Full-year CPI is projected around 2.02%, just above the central bank's 2% comfort line.

items.title_zh: 景氣對策信號續亮紅燈，景氣維持熱絡
items.title_en: Monitoring indicator stays "red" as economy runs hot
items.summary_zh: 台灣景氣對策信號續呈代表景氣熱絡的「紅燈」，近期綜合判斷分數維持在偏高水準。紅燈延續反映生產、出口與投資在 AI 循環帶動下的全面強勁，但也引發市場對景氣過熱風險與榮景可持續性的討論，尤其在全球晶片情緒轉弱之際更受關注。此情勢凸顯決策當局須在支撐成長與防範失衡之間審慎拿捏，貨幣與總經政策的節奏將是後市觀察重點。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's business-cycle monitoring indicator has remained at a "red" light, the signal for a booming economy, with the composite score holding at an elevated level in recent readings. The sustained red flash reflects strength across production, exports and investment tied to the AI cycle, but also raises questions about overheating risks and the durability of the boom should global chip sentiment sour, underscoring the delicate balance policymakers face between supporting growth and guarding against imbalances.

items.title_zh: 韓股 KOSPI 觸發熔斷，韓國晶片雙雄崩跌
items.title_en: KOSPI triggers circuit breaker as Korean chip giants collapse
items.summary_zh: 南韓 KOSPI 指數週二暴跌逾 10% 至約 6,023.66 點，寫下近一季最大單日跌幅，觸發熔斷機制暫停交易 20 分鐘，交易所並啟動 SIDECAR 限制程式賣單。三星電子與 SK 海力士分別重挫約 13%、15%，記憶體雙雄領跌全區半導體類股，對 AI 評價過高與中國競爭加劇的疑慮擴散至整個亞洲市場，避險情緒急速升溫，資金自科技股大舉撤出。
items.summary_en: South Korea's KOSPI plunged more than 10% on Tuesday to around 6,023.66, its steepest single-day fall in roughly a quarter, triggering a circuit breaker and a 20-minute trading halt as the exchange activated sidecar curbs on program selling. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix tumbled about 13% and 15% respectively, with the memory pair leading a region-wide semiconductor rout as fears over AI valuations and Chinese competition spread across Asian markets.

items.title_zh: 記憶體競爭疑慮升溫，韓廠自高點大幅回落
items.title_en: Memory-competition fears deepen as Korean chipmakers retrace from highs
items.summary_zh: 亞洲記憶體龍頭延續劇烈回檔，南韓兩大儲存巨頭已自 6 月高點大幅拉回，投資人在全球競爭加劇下重新評估產業。市場憂心中國半導體國產化進程、陸廠長鑫存儲即將上市，加上對輝達融資模式的疑慮，共同對 DRAM 與 HBM 族群形成壓力，顯示 AI 記憶體超級循環後市恐面臨更擁擠、更激烈的競爭格局，價格與市占的變數增加，供給端擴張須密切追蹤。
items.summary_en: Asian memory leaders extended a brutal retreat, with Korea's two storage giants having pulled back sharply from their June peaks as investors reassessed the sector amid intensifying global competition. Concerns over the mainland's semiconductor-nationalization drive and the pending listing of Chinese memory maker Changxin Storage, together with doubts about Nvidia's financing model, have combined to pressure DRAM and HBM names, signalling that the AI-memory super-cycle may face a more crowded and contested landscape ahead.

items.title_zh: 晶片股慘遭重擊，SK 海力士暴跌賣壓加深（2026-07-28）
items.title_en: Chip stocks clobbered as SK Hynix plunges and selloff deepens (2026-07-28)
items.summary_zh: 半導體股週二延續重挫，全球晶片賣壓加深，SK 海力士暴跌，美股 AMD、英特爾、美光同步走弱：英特爾收跌近 6%、AMD 跌約 8%、美光跌逾 8%，輝達開低後大致翻平作收，凸顯投資人對 AI 晶片需求的焦慮升高。
items.summary_en: Semiconductor shares extended sharp losses Tuesday as a global chip rout deepened, with SK Hynix plunging and US names AMD, Intel and Micron falling hard. Intel closed near 6% lower, AMD lost about 8% and Micron dropped more than 8%, while Nvidia ended roughly flat after a weak open, underscoring investor anxiety over AI-chip demand.

items.title_zh: 那斯達克 100 逼近修正區，AI 支出疑慮升溫（2026-07-28）
items.title_en: Nasdaq 100 nears correction as AI-spending worries mount (2026-07-28)
items.summary_zh: 那斯達克 100 指數逼近修正區，晶片賣壓轉劇，投資人質疑大型科技股投入 AI 的資本規模與最終回報，凸顯市場對 AI 建置浪潮成本與效益的不確定性升高，對最擁擠的動能交易形成壓力，資金風險偏好明顯轉趨保守。
items.summary_en: The Nasdaq 100 edged closer to a correction as the semiconductor selloff turned uglier and investors questioned how much Big Tech is spending on artificial intelligence and what returns it will generate. The move highlighted deepening uncertainty over the scale and eventual payoff of the AI buildout, pressuring the market's most crowded momentum trades.

items.title_zh: 道瓊靠財報收紅，晶片賣壓撕裂盤面（2026-07-28）
items.title_en: Dow rises on earnings even as chip sell-off splits the market (2026-07-28)
items.summary_zh: 美股週二漲跌互見，半導體與 AI 股賣壓抵銷藍籌股強勁財報帶來的漲勢：標普 500 漲 0.13%、道瓊漲 0.93%，那斯達克收黑，傳產贏家與遭重挫的晶片股走勢明顯分化，投資人轉向有財報支撐的個股，市場結構呈現兩極。
items.summary_en: US stocks were mixed Tuesday as a semiconductor and AI-stock sell-off offset gains from blue chips posting strong earnings. The S&P 500 rose 0.13% and the Dow climbed 0.93%, while the Nasdaq slipped, leaving a sharply divided tape between old-economy winners and battered chipmakers as investors rotated toward earnings-backed names.

items.title_zh: 道瓊勁揚約 520 點，那斯達克陷晶片恐慌（2026-07-28）
items.title_en: Dow jumps about 520 points while Nasdaq struggles through chip panic (2026-07-28)
items.summary_zh: 道瓊週二勁揚約 520 點，受企業財報強勁激勵，那斯達克綜合指數則在晶片股恐慌下收在約 24,876 點附近。盤面分化凸顯資金自漲多的 AI 晶片股輪動至較具防禦性、有財報支撐的藍籌股，交易員重新評估整體科技股評價，市場多空拉鋸加劇。
items.summary_en: The Dow surged roughly 520 points Tuesday, powered by strong corporate earnings, even as the Nasdaq Composite closed near 24,876 amid a semiconductor-driven panic. The split highlighted a rotation out of high-flying chip and AI names into more defensive, earnings-backed blue chips, as traders reassessed valuations across the technology complex.
